newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Chemunex ends Easdaq debut day easier.
newsitem.headline: Chemunex ends Easdaq debut day easier.

text.p: Shares in French microbiology firm Chemunex ended their first day of trading on European growth stocks market Easdaq slightly below their listing price of 18 French francs.
Chemunex's last trade was at the day's low of 17 francs, after it peaked at 19, with 1.08 million shares traded in total.

Chemunex, the eighth stock so far to be listed on the pan-European exchange, develops and markets very sensitive rapid testing systems for microbe contamination, mainly for the pharmaceutical, water and food industries.
